$comment: Upmo microcopy. ICU MessageFormat placeholders. Keys never change once shipped. See microcopy.md for the rules.
empty.tasks.title: Your first task
empty.tasks.body: Give Upmo a goal. It plans the work, does it and checks the result while you do something else.
empty.tasks_filtered.title: Nothing matches
empty.tasks_filtered.body: Try another status, agent or date range.
empty.chats.title: Start a chat
empty.chats.body: Ask a question, paste a file, or describe what you want done.
empty.artifacts.title: Nothing produced yet
empty.artifacts.body: Artifacts appear here as the task finishes its steps.
empty.artifact_preview.title: Upmo cannot preview this file
empty.artifact_preview.body: Download it to open it with an app on your computer.
empty.providers.title: Connect a provider
empty.providers.body: Upmo needs at least one model to think with. Local Ollama works without a key.
empty.connectors.title: Connect your tools
empty.connectors.body: GitHub, email, calendar and any MCP server. Agents use only the connectors you add.
empty.automations.title: Run tasks on a schedule
empty.automations.body: A daily digest, a weekly review, a check every hour.
empty.knowledge.title: Give Upmo something to read
empty.knowledge.body: Upload files or point to a folder. Agents search it when it helps.
empty.memory.title: Nothing remembered yet
empty.memory.body: Upmo keeps facts you tell it and lessons from tasks. You can delete any of them.
empty.search.title: No results for "{query}"
empty.search.body: Check the spelling or try a shorter word.
empty.notifications.title: You are up to date
empty.notifications.body: Approvals and finished tasks show up here.
empty.offline.title: Upmo is not reachable
empty.offline.body: Check that the server is running, then try again.
error.key_rejected: {provider} rejected the key. Check it in Settings and try again.
error.key_format: Enter a key that starts with {prefix}.
error.provider_unreachable: Upmo could not reach {provider}. Check your connection and try again.
error.rate_limited: {provider} is rate limiting requests. Upmo will retry in {seconds} s.
error.no_provider: No provider is connected. Add one in Settings to start.
error.model_unavailable: {model} is not available on {provider}. Pick another model.
error.budget_reached: The task reached its budget of {budget}. Raise the budget and resume, or stop here.
error.timeout: The task ran for {duration} without finishing. Stop it, or give it more time.
error.sandbox_failed: The sandbox could not start. Check that Docker is running on the server.
error.repo_not_found: Upmo could not find {repo}. Check the name and that the connector can read it.
error.repo_no_push: Upmo cannot push to {repo}. Pick a repository you can push to.
error.invalid_url: Enter a full address, starting with https://.
error.invalid_cron: Enter a valid schedule. Example: every weekday at 9:00.
error.file_too_large: {name} is larger than {max}. Pick a smaller file.
error.file_type: Upmo cannot read {type} files. Use PDF, text, Markdown, images or audio.
error.network: The server did not respond. Try again.
error.not_found: This {thing} no longer exists. It may have been deleted.
error.forbidden: You do not have access to this {thing}.
error.unknown: Something went wrong on the server. Try again, and if it keeps happening check the server logs.
confirm.delete_task.title: Delete "{name}"?
confirm.delete_task.body: Its runs, artifacts and sandbox are removed. This cannot be undone.
confirm.delete_chat.title: Delete this chat?
confirm.delete_chat.body: Messages are removed for good. Archive it instead to keep it.
confirm.stop_task.title: Stop "{name}"?
confirm.stop_task.body: Work done so far is kept. You can follow up later.
confirm.disconnect_provider.title: Disconnect {provider}?
confirm.disconnect_provider.body: Agents using its models will fail until you pick another.
confirm.remove_connector.title: Remove {connector} from {agent}?
confirm.remove_connector.body: The agent loses access at once. The connector stays available to others.
confirm.discard_changes.title: Discard changes?
confirm.discard_changes.body: What you typed in this form will be lost.
confirm.delete_key.title: Delete this key?
confirm.delete_key.body: Everything using it stops working. Add a new key first if you need continuity.
confirm.approve_action.title: Let {agent} {action}?
confirm.sign_out.title: Sign out?
toast.task_started.title: Task started
toast.task_done.title: Task done
toast.task_done.body: {name} produced {count, plural, one {# artifact} other {# artifacts}}.
toast.task_failed.title: Task failed
toast.needs_approval.title: Needs approval
toast.saved.title: Saved
toast.copied.title: Copied
toast.archived.title: Chat archived
toast.deleted.title: {thing} deleted
toast.connected.title: {provider} connected
toast.automation_on.title: Automation on
toast.offline.title: Connection lost
toast.online.title: Back online
toast.update.title: Upmo {version} is ready
field.goal.label: Goal
field.goal.description: What should be true when the task is done. Be specific about the result, not the steps.
field.goal.placeholder: Add a weekly spend report to the dashboard
field.task_name.label: Name (optional)
field.task_name.description: Shown in lists. Upmo suggests one from the goal.
field.agent.label: Agent
field.agent.description: Who does the work. The general agent handles most goals.
field.repo.label: Repository
field.repo.description: Where the agent works. Pick one the GitHub connector can push to.
field.budget.label: Budget
field.budget.description: The most this task may spend. It stops and asks when it gets there.
field.api_key.label: API key
field.api_key.description: From the {provider} dashboard, under API keys. Stored encrypted, never shown again.
field.base_url.label: Server address
field.base_url.description: Where the model runs. Local Ollama is http://localhost:11434.
field.model.label: Model
field.model.description: Which model answers. Cost per 1k tokens is shown next to each.
field.schedule.label: Schedule
field.schedule.description: When the automation runs, in your timezone ({tz}).
field.display_name.label: Your name
field.timezone.label: Timezone
field.timezone.description: Used for schedules and times in the app.
field.composer.placeholder: Ask anything, or describe a task
label.dictate_disabled: Enable the whisper profile to dictate
result.summary_pending: The final result shows up here when the task is done.
editor.read_only_reason: You can edit the files when the task stops.
delivery.title: Delivery
live.streaming_stopped: Stopped. The reply above is incomplete.
approval.title: {agent} wants to {action}
approval.body: {detail} Approve to continue, deny to let the agent find another way.
approval.expired: This approval expired. The task stopped.
agent.cannot: I cannot do that with the connectors I have. {alternative}
permission.changes.label: Changes
permission.changes.description: Creating, updating and sending. Deleting always asks first.
permission.reach.label: What it can reach
count.tasks: {count, plural, =0 {No tasks yet} one {# task} other {# tasks}}
count.chats: {count, plural, =0 {No chats yet} one {# chat} other {# chats}}
count.artifacts: {count, plural, =0 {No artifacts} one {# artifact} other {# artifacts}}
count.sources: {count, plural, =0 {No sources} one {# source} other {# sources}}
count.events: {count, plural, =0 {No events yet} one {# event} other {# events}}
